0: Across all four datasets, add a bounded relative-frequency input cue using item counts from training interactions only. For visible real items, compute log1p(count), center it over visible history items, divide by its history standard deviation plus 1e-6, and scale existing input item vectors by 1 + 0.05*tanh(z). Keep padding zero and mask-token scale 1; never use masked identities in feature computation. Relative frequency may distinguish niche context from common purchases without adding a scorer. Keep learned embeddings, topology, positions, readout, loss and optimizer fixed. Save count buffers in each category’s single checkpoint and reproduce the feature in the predictor writer.
1: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce dropout from 0.2 to 0.1 and learning rate from 1e-3 to 8e-4. Less dropout may preserve useful context in median seven-to-eight-item histories, while smaller updates may stabilize the less regularized network. Unlike the earlier unsuccessful wider-model trial, retain width 64, two blocks, two heads and 2× feed-forward width. Keep batch size 128, history length 128, features, embedding normalization/tying, loss and optimizer unchanged. Retain seed 42, the 200-epoch cap, 200 batches per epoch and one checkpoint per category.
2: Across all four datasets, double the radius used by effective_item_weight while retaining L2-normalized, tied item embeddings: use 2*sqrt(2*hidden_units/(itemnum+2+hidden_units)) for every nonpadding row, including the exclusive mask token. The current vocabulary-dependent radius may make item identity weak relative to positional embeddings; a larger radius may strengthen contextual item information and output gradients. Keep padding zero, dimensions, features, backbone, history policy, scoring formula, loss and optimizer unchanged. Apply the same effective weights in training and generated prediction, with one model per category.
3: Across all four datasets, replace chronological position ranks with reverse nonpadding ranks: the final real or masked position receives position ID 1, its predecessor 2, and so on; padding remains 0. Reuse the existing positional table and retain the appended-mask state as the sole inference readout. Recency-aligned positions may transfer last-item context across variable history lengths more effectively than start-aligned ranks. Retain history length 128, bidirectional masked-target training, features, item embedding parameterization, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer. Update the predictor writer consistently and retain one checkpoint per category.
